name: shah-mosque
description: Blue and turquoise haft-rangi tile surfaces; four iwans and three domed chambers around a rotated main sahn, independent square-facing portal, twin minarets at portal and sanctuary, side madrasa courts.
attribution: Survey plans © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0. Architectural geometry originally authored for Vearth.

audit.dimension_uncertainty: Published25m dome is treated as inner diameter; roof is26.8m before onion bulge. Provider circle spans33m and is used for center only. Small tile ornament is original geometric interpretation; inscriptions are not fabricated.
audit.orientation: Source footprints in east/north metric coordinates; all component rotations baked into vertices.
audit.grounding: Hassan II floor uses published 9.50m NGM with authored sea-level basement supports; Shah/Qaboos use clean approach calibration in mosque-floor-calibrations.json. Bounded cuts stay beneath authored masonry/paving.
audit.approach_grounding: Independent bounded entrance grades retain fixed floors and the Qaboos raised platform; measured levels, mapped approach axes and estimated blend extents are recorded in shah-qaboos-setting-ground.json.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
